about: Real openinference-instrumentation-llama-index spans (Python) from llama-index-llms-openai, recorded against a scripted OpenAI through an in-process httpx mock transport (llama-index-llms-openai still pins openai 2.x, which uses httpx, not httpx2): no network, no API keys, no rius SDK. Only the LlamaIndex instrumentor is enabled. Its llm.invocation_parameters holds the model's metadata (context_window, num_output, model_name), not the request's parameters.
record: python record.py <recording.json> <environment.json>, in a virtualenv holding exactly the pins below

scenarios.chat: OpenAI.chat with a system and a user message, temperature and max_tokens set (the instrumentor records neither).
scenarios.tool_call: chat_with_tools: an LLM-kind _prepare_chat_with_tools span, then the chat span; the response is a tool call.
scenarios.tool_response: chat_with_tools with the assistant's tool call and the tool's result in the history, a text answer out.
scenarios.error: The provider answers 401 (invalid_api_key). LlamaIndex rejects an unknown model name before sending, so the error comes from the provider instead.

openinference-llama-index-4.6.0.json.verified: Re-recorded 2026-10-12 twice in a row in the pinned virtualenv: byte-identical.
